queue.hypothesis: Set conv_kernel to 1 to eliminate local convolution interference and let GatedDeltaNet handle all long-range dependencies
queue.rationale: Multiple experiments have failed with conv_kernel=4, likely due to interference between local convolution and global FLA mechanisms. Setting conv_kernel=1 removes the convolution entirely, allowing the GatedDeltaNet recurrent state to handle all associative memory without competing inductive biases. This was partially tried in iter_224 but needs to be tested cleanly.
queue.instruction: In .autoresearch/experiment_config.yaml, change the conv_kernel parameter value from 4 to 1. This eliminates the local convolution layer and lets the GatedDeltaNet handle all sequence dependencies through its recurrent mechanism.
